import subprocess

def create_backup(db_name, backup_dir):
    # Create database backup
    cmd = f"mysqldump -u root -psecret {db_name} > {backup_dir}/{db_name}.sql"
    subprocess.call(cmd, shell=True)

def restore_backup(db_name, backup_file):
    cmd = f"mysql -u root -psecret {db_name} < {backup_file}"
    subprocess.call(cmd, shell=True)
